words, command = matched\n\n    args = argv[len(words):]\n    if len(args) < command.min_args or (command.max_args is not None and len(args) > command.max_args):\n        return _usage_error(f\"wrong sys.stdout.write(_format(rows))\n    return EXIT_OK\n=== cli/registry.py\n\"\"\"Command registry: maps command words to handlers, filled from the modules in ``cli/commands/``.\"\"\"\n\nimport Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"code\")\n    if not _CODE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_name(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"name\")\n    _check_length(text, \"name\", 1, NAME_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"name\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_memo(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"memo\")\n    _check_length(text, \"memo\", 0, MEMO_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"memo\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept a real calendar date year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date is not a real calendar date: {text}\") from exc\n    return value\n=== ledger_core/balances.py\n\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n=== ledger_core/money.py\n\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n=== ledger_core/errors.py\n\"\"\"Domain errors. Each carries the process exit code the CLI reports.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Base class for every domain error the ledger raises.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Invalid input, duplicate key, unknown reference, account in use, or negative balance.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An account or transaction is absent on get, rename, delete, or amend.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An unreadable file or an unopenable database.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n=== ledger_core/config.py\n\"\"\"Runtime configuration: where the ledger database lives.\"\"\"\n\nimport os\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\nSQLITE_URL_PREFIX = \"sqlite://\"\n\n\ndef _non_empty(name: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the environment variable's value, or None when unset or empty.\"\"\"\n    value = os.environ.get(name)\n    return value if value else None\n\n\ndef database_path() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Resolve the database location.\n\n    Precedence: ``DATABASE_URL`` (with an optional leading ``sqlite://`` removed),\n    then ``DATABASE_PATH``, then ``data/app.db``. Shipped engines plus the schema generated from DATABASE.md.\"\"\"\n\nfrom .db import Database, PersistenceError, UnknownOperation\nfrom .schema import SCHEMA, open_database\n\n__all__ = [\"Database\", \"PersistenceError\", \"SCHEMA\", \"UnknownOperation\", \"open_database\"]\n=== persistence/testing.py\n\"\"\"Generated fixtures over the configured, already provisioned application store.\"\"\"\n\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom .schema import open_database\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef committed_session():\n    \"\"\"Use normal autocommit for project tests; under the acceptance harness, its transaction.\"\"\"\n    configured = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_URL\") or os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\") or \"data/app.db\"\n    if not configured.startswith((\"postgres://\", \"postgresql://\")):\n        if not Path(configured.split(\"://\", 1)[-1]).is_file():\n            raise RuntimeError(\"persistence store missing; rebuild the DATABASE step\")\n    database = open_database(configured)\n    try:\n        yield database\n    finally:\n        database.close()\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef db_session():\n    \"\"\"Share this connection with the feature; always roll back, never provision schema.\n\n    Under the acceptance harness the rollback is the harness's, at the end of the criterion, so\n    a request made after this block still sees the setup.\n    \"\"\"\n    with committed_session() as database:\n        with database.rollback_session():\n            yield database\n=== persistence/db.py\n\"\"\"Persistence access for a Drydock Target.\n\nThis file is shipped by Drydock and copied into the build unchanged. Do not edit it here: edit\n``DATABASE.md`` and rebuild. It is hardened and tested once, in Drydock's own suite, so every\nTarget inherits a persistence layer that has already passed rather than one re-derived from prose\non each build.\n\nThe application-facing surface is ``Database``. One attribute per declared table, one method per\ndeclared access pattern::\n\n    db = Database(dsn, SCHEMA)\n    ticket = db.tickets.get(id=7)\n    open_tickets = db.tickets.list(status=\"open\")\n\n``schema.py`` beside this file is generated from ``DATABASE.md`` and carries the tables, the\noperations, and the row types. It contains no SQL. Statements are constructed here, by the driver\nfor the engine in use, so a parameter placeholder never appears in generated code or in a caller.\n\nValues reach the database as bound parameters, never as formatted text. Identifiers cannot be\nbound in any engine, so they are taken only from the generated schema — which Drydock validated\nagainst ``^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`` before emitting it — and are quoted on the way out.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext\nimport threading\nfrom typing import Any\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"Database\",\n    \"Driver\",\n    \"Operation\",\n    \"PersistenceError\",\n    \"Schema\",\n    \"Table\",\n    \"statements\",\n    \"UnknownOperation\",\n    \"begin_acceptance_transaction\",\n    \"end_acceptance_transaction\",\n]\n\nVERBS = (\"get\", \"list\", \"create\", \"update\", \"delete\")\n#: The comparisons a declared Match term may state; anything else is refused before SQL is built.\nCOMPARISONS = (\"=\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\")\nDIRECTIONS = (\"asc\", \"desc\")\n\n\nclass PersistenceError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"A persistence failure the caller may act on, raised in place of a driver exception.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UnknownOperation(PersistenceError):\n    \"\"\"A verb was requested that the declaration does not grant for that table.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Table:\n    \"\"\"One declared table: its columns and the column that identifies a row.\"\"\"\n\n    name: str\n    columns: tuple[str, ...]\n    primary_key: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Operation:\n    \"\"\"One declared access pattern, reduced to what executing it requires.\n\n    ``name`` is the method callers use and ``verb`` is its Kind, how it runs; a name that is a\n    verb runs as that verb. ``inputs`` are the parameters the caller supplies. ``match`` is the\n    equality predicate of a ``get``, ``update``, ``upsert``, or ``delete``, every field of it\n    required; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GbB7qwzToX7bkkKbYPrKN9","type":"tool_result","content":"=== ledger_core/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Domain logic for the cash ledger.\n\nOwnership: only the generated ``persistence`` package touches the database.\nModules here never import a database driver, and money is integer cents\neverywhere; floating point is never used for money.\n\"\"\"\n=== ledger_core/validation.py\n\"\"\"Pure validation of codes, names, memos, and dates.\n\nEach function returns the validated value unchanged, or raises ``Rejected``. Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EC98KWo5FXbkm6DkBL9e89","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Persistence access for a Drydock Target.\n\nThis file is shipped by Drydock and copied into the build unchanged. Do not edit it here: edit\n``DATABASE.md`` and rebuild. It is hardened and tested once, in Drydock's own suite, so every\nTarget inherits a persistence layer that has already passed rather than one re-derived from prose\non each build.\n\nThe application-facing surface is ``Database``. One attribute per declared table, one method per\ndeclared access pattern::\n\n    db = Database(dsn, SCHEMA)\n    ticket = db.tickets.get(id=7)\n    open_tickets = db.tickets.list(status=\"open\")\n\n``schema.py`` beside this file is generated from ``DATABASE.md`` and carries the tables, the\noperations, and the row types. It contains no SQL. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MMfQFK7ohmNfPyVovceNfZ","type":"tool_result","content":"        if operation.verb == \"delete\" and not arguments:\n            raise PersistenceError(f\"{operation.identifier} requires a delete predicate\")\n        names = [name for name in operation.inputs if name in arguments]\n        values = [arguments[name] for name in names]\n        # The harness's one connection serves the criterion and the application's request\n        # threads alike, so an operation holds it for its whole statement and savepoint.\n        with self._harness.lock if self._harness is not None else nullcontext():\n            scoped = self._rollback_owner is not None or self._harness is not None\n            cursor = self._open(operation.identifier)\n            try:\n                if scoped:\n                    cursor.execute(\"SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                result = self._dispatch(operation, cursor, names, values)\n                if scoped:\n                    cursor.execute(\"RELEASE SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                return result\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - translated at the boundary on purpose\n                if scoped:\n                    cursor.execute(\"ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                    cursor.execute(\"RELEASE SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                raise PersistenceError(f\"{operation.identifier} failed: {exc}\") from exc\n            finally:\n                cursor.close()\n\n    def _open(self, action: str) -> Any:\n        \"\"\"Return a cursor, translating a refused or failed connection.\"\"\"\n        if self._rollback_owner not in (None, threading.get_ident()):\n            raise PersistenceError(\"rollback session requires its owning thread and connection\")\n        try:\n            return self._driver.connect().cursor()\n        except PersistenceError:\n            raise\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - translated at the boundary on purpose\n            raise PersistenceError(f\"{action} could not connect: {exc}\") from exc\n\n    def _dispatch(\n        self,\n        operation: Operation,\n        cursor: Any,\n        names: list[str],\n        values: list[Any],\n    ) -> Any:\n        verb = operation.verb\n        table = operation.table\n        match = self._match(operation)\n        if verb in (\"get\", \"list\"):\n            columns = operation.columns or self._columns(table)\n            statement = self._driver.select(\n                table, columns, names, operation.compare, operation.order\n            )\n            cursor.execute(statement, values)\n=== sqlite.py\n\"\"\"SQLite engine for ``db.py``.\n\nShipped by Drydock and copied into the build unchanged. Do not edit it here.\n\nSQLite is the development and test engine. It parses the same declaration PostgreSQL does and\nignores what it does not enforce — ``VARCHAR(n)`` length in particular — so one rendered schema\nserves both engines and nothing is stripped for one of them.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nimport threading\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\ntry:\n    from .db import Driver\nexcept ImportError:  # flat layout\n    from db import Driver\n\n__all__ = [\"SqliteDriver\"]\n\n\nclass SqliteDriver(Driver):\n    \"\"\"One connection per thread, opened on first use in that thread.\n\n    A ``sqlite3.Connection`` belongs to the thread that created it and raises ``ProgrammingError``\n    when used from another, so a single connection opened during construction is valid in no web\n    request at all. This is not concurrency: queries stay sequential within a workflow, and the\n    rule only stops one connection being shared across unrelated ones.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    paramstyle = \"qmark\"\n    returning = False\n\n    def __init__(self, dsn: str) -> None:\n        self._path = _path_from(dsn)\n        self._local = threading.local()\n        self._pinned: sqlite3.Connection | None = None\n\n    def connect(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n        if self._pinned is not None:\n            return self._pinned\n        connection = getattr(self._local, \"connection\", None)\n        if connection is None:\n            connection = self._open()\n            self._local.connection = connection\n        return connection\n\n    def pin(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n        # Shared across threads on purpose; ``Database`` serializes every operation on it.\n        if self._pinned is None:\n            self._pinned = self._open(check_same_thread=False)\n        return self._pinned\n\n    def identity(self) -> str:\n        return self._path if self._path == \":memory:\" else str(Path(self._path).resolve())\n\n    def _open(self, *, check_same_thread: bool = True) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n        if self._path != \":memory:\":\n            Path(self._path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        # Autocommit by default; CSV reader for the ``ledger load`` commands.\n\nThe reader only reads: it never touches the database and never writes to a file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\n\nRow = tuple[int, list[str]]\n\n\ndef read_rows(path: str, header: Sequence[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(line_number, fields)`` for every data row of ``path``, in file order.\n\n    ``header`` lists the column names the table requires, in order. Line numbers are 1-based, so the\n    first data row after a header on line 1 is line 2. Blank lines are skipped. Raises ``Operational``\n    when the file cannot be read or decoded, and ``Rejected`` when the header differs, the file is\n    empty, or a data row's field count differs from ``len(header)``.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            return _read(fh, path, list(header))\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc.strerror or exc}\") from exc\n    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot decode {path} as UTF-8: {exc}\") from exc\n\n\ndef _read(fh, path: str, header: list[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    reader = csv.reader(fh)\n    try:\n        first = next(reader, None)\n        if first is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} is empty; expected header {','.join(header)}\")\n        if first != header:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line 1: header must be {','.join(header)}\")\n        rows: list[Row] = []\n        for fields in reader:\n            if not fields:\n                continue\n            if len(fields) != len(header):\n                raise Rejected(\n                    f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: expected {len(header)} fields, found {len(fields)}\"\n                )\n            rows.append((reader.line_num, fields))\n        return rows\n    except csv.Error as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}\") from exc\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014qznohmNAbSReqKKF8h1JL","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/transactions.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d7a534b1-466b-42b2-8b8c-1b08933a187f","uuid":"ed4761b4-20a0-4763-845e-2c75eca45bcc","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:30:37.169Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/transactions.py","content":"\"\"\"Transaction rows: formatting a stored transaction for output, and the next free transaction id.\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom persistence import Database\nfrom persistence.schema import TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput\n\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\nStoredTxn = Union[TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput]\n\n\ndef txn_row(txn: StoredTxn) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Format a stored transaction as the output row ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo``.\"\"\"\n    return [str(txn.txn_id), txn.date, txn.account, txn.category, format_cents(txn.amount), txn.memo]\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db: Database) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the largest stored ``txn_id`` plus one, or ``1`` when the ledger has no transactions.\"\"\"\n    return max((txn.txn_id for txn in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_014qznohmNAbSReqKKF8h1JL","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSuJMMamePC7a4TeQmff","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FgG1VLKpwAYoDR3mgq4eYG","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/maintenance.py","content":"\"\"\"Maintenance commands: ``ledger init`` empties the ledger, ``ledger count`` reports table row counts.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\nSCHEMA_SQL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"schema.sql\"\n\n\ndef _ensure_schema(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Apply the declared DDL when the store has no tables yet. A provisioned store is left alone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        db.transactions.list()\n    except PersistenceError:\n        db.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema(db)\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":16346,"cache_read_input_tokens":63615,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":16346},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d7a534b1-466b-42b2-8b8c-1b08933a187f","uuid":"1e9fa776-5432-4e5c-adb2-d8a10ae068a5","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:30:40.807Z","request_id":"req_011CgSuJLwGtSSKaurNamPhq","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01FgG1VLKpwAYoDR3mgq4eYG":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/maintenance.py","content":"\"\"\"Maintenance commands: ``ledger init`` empties the ledger, ``ledger count`` reports table row counts.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\nSCHEMA_SQL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"schema.sql\"\n\n\ndef _ensure_schema(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Apply the declared DDL when the store has no tables yet. A provisioned store is left alone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        db.transactions.list()\n    except PersistenceError:\n        db.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema(db)\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FgG1VLKpwAYoDR3mgq4eYG","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/maintenance.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d7a534b1-466b-42b2-8b8c-1b08933a187f","uuid":"2f0ad54d-7e80-4b1e-9411-d3fae3c2bfaf","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:30:40.931Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/maintenance.py","content":"\"\"\"Maintenance commands: ``ledger init`` empties the ledger, ``ledger count`` reports table row counts.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\nSCHEMA_SQL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"schema.sql\"\n\n\ndef _ensure_schema(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Apply the declared DDL when the store has no tables yet. A provisioned store is left alone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        db.transactions.list()\n    except PersistenceError:\n        db.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema(db)\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01FgG1VLKpwAYoDR3mgq4eYG","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

init`` and ``ledger count``: fresh stores, emptying, counting, and usage errors.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n\ndef _counts(out: str) -> list[int]:\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"table\", \"rows\"]\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows[1:]] == [\"accounts\", \"categories\", \"transactions\"]\n    return [int(row[1]) for row in rows[1:]]\n\n\ndef _seed_one_of_each(path, store_open):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZMA1\", name=\"Maint Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZZMC1\", description=\"Maint Cat\")\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=910000001, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZZMA1\",\n                               category=\"ZZMC1\", amount=100, memo=\"\")\n\n\ndef test_init_creates_missing_store_and_schema(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    path = tmp_path / \"fresh.db\"\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", str(path))\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", raising=False)\n    assert not path.exists()\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert path.exists()\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_init_on_empty_ledger_exits_zero_again(ledger_store):\n    for _ in range(2):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n        assert code == 0, err\n        assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_init_removes_every_row_from_all_three_tables(ledger_store, store_open):\n    _seed_one_of_each(ledger_store, store_open)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.transactions.list() == []\n        assert db.categories.list() == []\n        assert db.accounts.list() == []\n\n\ndef test_init_leaves_no_rows_even_with_many_stored(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        for i in range(25):\n            db.accounts.create(account=f\"ZZMM{i:02d}\", name=\"Many\")\n            db.categories.create(category=f\"ZZMK{i:02d}\", description=\"Many\")\n            db.transactions.create(txn_id=920000000 + i, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=f\"ZZMM{i:02d}\",\n                                   category=f\"ZZMK{i:02d}\", amount=-1 if i else 1, memo=\"\")\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_count_reports_zero_on_empty_ledger(ledger_store):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_count_reports_each_stored_row(ledger_store, store_open):\n    _seed_one_of_each(ledger_store, store_open)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [1, 1, 1]\n\n\ndef test_count_rises_by_one_per_write(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    before = _counts(out)\n    _seed_one_of_each(ledger_store, store_open)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [n + 1 for n in before]\n\n\ndef test_count_is_read_from_the_store_each_run(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert _counts(out) == [0, 0, 0]\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZMC2\", name=\"Later\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert _counts(out) == [1, 0, 0]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"command\", [\"init\", \"count\"])\ndef test_extra_argument_is_usage_error(ledger_store, command):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(command, \"extra\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_init_refuses_nothing_on_a_missing_parent_directory(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", str(tmp_path / \"absent\" / \"ledger.db\"))\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", raising=False)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert not (tmp_path / \"absent\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_rejected_error_type_is_not_used_by_init():\n    # init has no domain rejection: every failure is operational and surfaces as exit 1, not 3.\n    assert not issubclass(Rejected, {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSuKvn24dJSZpNEki9Nt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JXnhpDCzcfyVGYhi6U8PHd","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger account add`` and the ``account_row`` helper, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef test_add_prints_header_and_zero_row(ledger_store):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNA1\", \"Add Probe\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZZNA1\", \"Add Probe\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n\n\ndef test_added_account_reads_back_from_the_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNA2\", \"Read Back\")\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZNA2\")\n        assert row is not None\n        assert row.name == \"Read Back\"\n\n\ndef test_added_account_is_listed_once(ledger_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNA3\", \"Listed\")\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert [row.account for row in db.accounts.list()] == [\"ZZNA3\"]\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_code_is_rejected_and_name_unchanged(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNB1\", \"Original Name\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNB1\", \"Different Name\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZNB1\").name == \"Original Name\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"zznc1\", \"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"ZZ-NC\", \"ZZ NC\", \"\", \"ZZé\"])\ndef test_invalid_code_is_rejected_and_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, \"Valid Name\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.list() == []\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"\", \"n\" * 41, \"has,comma\", \"line\\nbreak\"])\ndef test_invalid_name_is_rejected_and_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZND1\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZND1\") is None\n\n\ndef test_largest_code_and_name_are_stored_whole(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code_text, name = \"Z\" * 12, \"n\" * 40\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_text, name)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [code_text, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=code_text).name == name\n\n\ndef test_single_character_code_and_name_are_accepted(ledger_store):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"A\", \"n\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"A\", \"n\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"args\",\n    [(\"account\", \"add\"), (\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNE1\"), (\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNE1\", \"Name\", \"Extra\")],\n)\ndef test_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(ledger_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_account_row_reports_count_and_cent_balance(ledger_store, store_open):\n    amounts = [10000, -2550, 1]\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZNF1\", name=\"Helper Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZZNFC\", description=\"Helper Category\")\n        for i, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n            db.transactions.create(txn_id=930000000 + i, date=\"2026-03-01\", account=\"ZZNF1\",\n                                   category=\"ZZNFC\", amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n        row = account_row(db, \"ZZNF1\")\n    assert tuple(row) == (\"ZZNF1\", \"Helper Probe\", len(amounts), sum(amounts))\n\n\ndef test_account_row_is_none_for_absent_account(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert account_row(db, \"ZZNFNONE\") is None\n\n\ndef account_row\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef test_add_prints_header_and_zero_row(ledger_store):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNA1\", \"Add Probe\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZZNA1\", \"Add Probe\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n\n\ndef test_added_account_reads_back_from_the_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNA2\", \"Read Back\")\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZNA2\")\n        assert row is not None\n        assert row.name == \"Read Back\"\n\n\ndef test_added_account_is_listed_once(ledger_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNA3\", \"Listed\")\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert [row.account for row in db.accounts.list()] == [\"ZZNA3\"]\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_code_is_rejected_and_name_unchanged(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNB1\", \"Original Name\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNB1\", \"Different Name\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZNB1\").name == \"Original Name\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"zznc1\", \"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"ZZ-NC\", \"ZZ NC\", \"\", \"ZZé\"])\ndef test_invalid_code_is_rejected_and_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, \"Valid Name\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.list() == []\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"\", \"n\" * 41, \"has,comma\", \"line\\nbreak\"])\ndef test_invalid_name_is_rejected_and_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZND1\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZND1\") is None\n\n\ndef test_largest_code_and_name_are_stored_whole(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code_text, name = \"Z\" * 12, \"n\" * 40\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_text, name)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [code_text, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=code_text).name == name\n\n\ndef test_single_character_code_and_name_are_accepted(ledger_store):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"A\", \"n\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"A\", \"n\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"args\",\n    [(\"account\", \"add\"), (\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNE1\"), (\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNE1\", \"Name\", \"Extra\")],\n)\ndef test_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(ledger_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_account_row_reports_count_and_cent_balance(ledger_store, store_open):\n    amounts = [10000, -2550, 1]\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZNF1\", name=\"Helper Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZZNFC\", description=\"Helper Category\")\n        for i, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n            db.transactions.create(txn_id=930000000 + i, date=\"2026-03-01\", account=\"ZZNF1\",\n                                   category=\"ZZNFC\", amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n        row = account_row(db, \"ZZNF1\")\n    assert tuple(row) == (\"ZZNF1\", \"Helper Probe\", len(amounts), sum(amounts))\n\n\ndef test_account_row_is_none_for_absent_account(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert account_row(db, \"ZZNFNONE\") is None\n\n\ndef test_account_row_is_zero_for_account_without_transactions(ledger_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNG1\", \"Empty\")\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert account_row(db, \"ZZNG1\") == (\"ZZNG1\", \"Empty\", 0, 0)\n"}}}

txn post``, ``txn_row``, and ``next_txn_id``, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import next_txn_id, txn_row\nfrom persistence.schema import TransactionsGetOutput\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCOUNT = \"ZZTA1\"\nCATEGORY = \"ZZTC1\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef posting_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"A store with one account and one category, ready for postings.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCOUNT, name=\"Post Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Post Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) \"\"\n    assert len(_stored(store_open, posting_store)) == 2\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"args\",\n    [\n        (\"txn\", \"post\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"1.00\"),\n        (\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"m\", \"extra\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(posting_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_txn_row_formats_stored_fields(posting_store):\n    txn = TransactionsGetOutput(txn_id=7, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=ACCOUNT, category=CATEGORY,\n                                amount=-1205, memo=\"rent\")\n    assert txn_row(txn) == [\"7\", \"2026-06-01\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"-12.05\", \"rent\"]\n\n\ndef test_next_txn_id_is_one_on_empty_ledger(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert next_txn_id(db) == 1\n\n\ndef test_next_txn_id_is_largest_plus_one(posting_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(posting_store) as db:\n        for txn_id in (3, 11, 7):\n            db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=ACCOUNT,\n                                   category=CATEGORY, amount=1, memo=\"\")\n        assert next_txn_id(db) == db.transactions.create(txn_id=910000001, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZZMA1\",\n                               category=\"ZZMC1\", amount=100, memo=\"\")\n\n\ndef test_init_creates_missing_store_and_schema(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    path = tmp_path / \"fresh.db\"\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", str(path))\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", raising=False)\n    assert not path.exists()\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert path.exists()\n    code, out, err = with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        for i in range(25):\n            db.accounts.create(account=f\"ZZMM{i:02d}\", name=\"Many\")\n            db.categories.create(category=f\"ZZMK{i:02d}\", test_count_reports_each_stored_row(ledger_store, store_open):\n    _seed_one_of_each(ledger_store, store_open)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [1, 1, 1]\n\n\ndef test_count_rises_by_one_per_write(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    before = _counts(out)\n cli_runner\n\n\ndef _counts(out: str) -> list[int]:\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"table\", \"rows\"]\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows[1:]] == [\"accounts\", \"categories\", \"transactions\"]\n    return [int(row[1]) for row in rows[1:]]\n\n\ndef _seed_one_of_each(path, store_open):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZMA1\", name=\"Maint Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZZMC1\", description=\"Maint Cat\")\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=910000001, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZZMA1\",\n                               category=\"ZZMC1\", amount=100, memo=\"\")\n\n\ndef test_init_creates_missing_store_and_schema(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    path = tmp_path / \"fresh.db\"\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", str(path))\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", raising=False)\n    assert not path.exists()\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert path.exists()\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_init_on_empty_ledger_exits_zero_again(ledger_store):\n    for _ in range(2):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n        assert code == 0, err\n        assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_init_removes_every_row_from_all_three_tables(ledger_store, store_open):\n    _seed_one_of_each(ledger_store, store_open)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        assert db.transactions.list() == []\n        assert db.categories.list() == []\n        assert db.accounts.list() == []\n\n\ndef test_init_leaves_no_rows_even_with_many_stored(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        for i in range(25):\n            db.accounts.create(account=f\"ZZMM{i:02d}\", name=\"Many\")\n            db.categories.create(category=f\"ZZMK{i:02d}\", description=\"Many\")\n            db.transactions.create(txn_id=920000000 + i, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _counts(out) == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_count_reports_each_stored_row(ledger_store, store_open):\n test_count_rises_by_one_per_write(ledger_store, store_open):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    before = _counts(out)\n    _seed_one_of_each(ledger_store, store_open)\n    code, out, err = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSuQyWsg5noXuMnkeeU9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Block 5 is implemented: `init`, `count`, `account add`, `txn post`, and the CSV reader. The project suite passes, 237 tests, run with the project venv's pytest.\n\nTwo things differ from the spec wording and are worth a look:\n\n- **`init` applies the schema itself.** Nothing creates tables when a store opens, so `init` runs `schema.sql` on a store that has no tables yet. It probes with a read first, because the acceptance harness forbids schema SQL. A provisioned store is left alone.\n- **`count` on a fresh store without `init` exits 1** with \"no such table\". That follows from the first point.\n\nThe spec's acceptance blocks are not runnable here: they import `drydock_acceptance`, which is not in this build. I wrote project tests covering the same assertions, and they run against a fresh store per test, so nothing writes to `data/app.db`.\n\nAlso noticed, not changed: `ledger` refuses to open a store whose directory is missing, so `init` on a fresh checkout with no `data/` directory exits 1. That behavior is from block 3's entry point.\n\nFiles added:\n- `ledger_core/csvio.py`\n- `ledger_core/accounts.py`\n- `ledger_core/transactions.py`\n- `cli/commands/maintenance.py`\n- `cli/commands/accounts.py`\n- `cli/commands/transactions.py`\n- `tests/conftest.py`\n- `tests/test_csvio.py`\n- `tests/test_maintenance.py`\n- `tests/test_accounts.py`\n- `tests/test_transactions.py`\n\nNo commit was made, per the build rules.\n\n<blueprint-decisions>\n[{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-InitCount.md\",\"severity\":\"Material\",\"subject\":\"Schema creation on init\",\"decision\":\"The spec says opening the database creates the declared schema, but the entry point does not do that and nothing else does. I made init apply schema.sql when the store has no tables, probing with a read first because execute_script is forbidden under the acceptance harness. The alternative was changing the block-3 entry point to create the schema on every open. Should opening create the schema for all commands, or stay with init-only creation?\"}]\n</blueprint-decisions>\n\nRESULT: SUCCESS\n\nFILES CHANGED:\n- cli/commands/maintenance.py\n- cli/commands/accounts.py\n- cli/commands/transactions.py\n- ledger_core/accounts.py\n- ledger_core/csvio.py\n- ledger_core/transactions.py\n- tests/conftest.py\n- tests/test_csvio.py\n- tests/test_maintenance.py\n- tests/test_accounts.py\n- tests/test_transactions.py\n\nSUMMARY:\n- `ledger init` applies `schema.sql` to a store with no tables, then clears transactions, categories, and accounts in that order. It prints nothing and exits 0. A second run also exits 0.\n- `ledger count` prints `table,rows` and the three counts, each read from `list()`.\n- `ledger account add <code> <name>` validates, rejects a duplicate with exit 3, inserts, and prints the account row with balance `0.00`. `account_row` computes the transaction count and cent balance on each call.\n- `ledger txn post` checks amount, date, and memo, then the account, then the category, then the no-negative-balance rule. Only after all of these does it insert. The txn_id is the largest stored id plus one, or 1 when empty.\n- `read_rows(path, header)` raises `Operational` for an unreadable, missing, or undecodable file. It raises `Rejected` for a wrong header, an empty file, or a wrong field count, and returns numbered rows with blank lines skipped.\n- Tests run in `pytest -q` with `.venv/bin/pytest`: 237 passed. Every CLI-writing test uses a fresh store under `tmp_path`. Nothing writes to `data/app.db`.\n- Not run: the spec's acceptance blocks verbatim, because they need `drydock_acceptance`, which is not in this build.\n\nBLOCKERS:\n- None."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":741,"cache_read_input_tokens":95640,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":741},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d7a534b1-466b-42b2-8b8c-1b08933a187f","uuid":"456d1850-6f6d-45e1-b13e-963cf31319f5","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:32:16.139Z","request_id":"req_011CgSuQyCX2DaCiTQGJ2bqW"}
